The '''2025 Diamond League''' was the sixteenth season of the [[Diamond League|annual series]] of outdoor [[track and field]] meetings, organised by [[World Athletics]]. The competition was a revision to the top level [[sport of athletics|athletics]] series since [[Diamond League]] foundation in 2010. The number of Diamond Discipline events was 32. Each meeting hosted a number of Diamond Discipline events and some of these events would not be broadcast. Events losing Diamond Discipline status would feature on the [[World Athletics Continental Tour]], the second tier of track and field meetings.

Starting in 2025, each meeting nominated 4 events (2 male and 2 female) to be Diamond+ Disciplines, these events will have increased levels of prize money; this will mean at regular meetings a doubling of the 1st place prize from $10,000 to $20,000 and at the Diamond League Finals an increase to $50,000.<ref name=":0">{{cite web |title=Wanda Diamond League prize money structure in 2025 |url=https://www.diamondleague.com/news/general/wanda-diamond-league-prize-money-structure-in-2025/ |website=Diamond League |access-date=9 April 2025 |date=23 December 2024}}</ref>

The series concluded with the Diamond League Finals in [[Zürich]], on the 27th and 28th August 2025.

==Schedule==
The following fifteen meetings are scheduled to be included in the 2025 season.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://worldathletics.org/competitions/diamond-league/calendar-results?season=2025 |title=Diamond League calendar 2025 |access-date=10 September 2024 |website=[[World Athletics]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=26 September 2024 |title=Wanda Diamond League 2025: Allocation of Diamond Disciplines |url=https://www.diamondleague.com/fileadmin/IDL_Silesia/user_upload/WDL_2025_-_Allocation_of_disciplines_by_meeting.pdf |access-date=7 October 2024 |website=[[Diamond League]]}}</ref>

== Diamond+ Disciplines ==
Starting in 2025, each Diamond League meeting can nominate four “Diamond+ Disciplines” (two male and two female). These disciplines will offer higher levels of prize money, with the maximum for individual athletes rising from $10,000 to $20,000.<ref name=":0" /> In March 2025, the Diamond+ disciplines at the first four meetings were announced.<ref>{{Cite web |date=3 March 2025 |title=Diamond+ Disciplines announced for first four meetings |url=https://www.diamondleague.com/diamond-disciplines-announced-for-last-three-series-meetings/ |access-date=10 April 2025 |website=[[Diamond League|diamondleague.com]]}}</ref> More Diamond+ Disciplines were announced throughout the rest of the season.<ref>{{Cite web |date=9 April 2025 |title=Diamond+ Disciplines announced for second four meetings |url=https://www.diamondleague.com/diamond-disciplines-announced-for-second-four-meetings/ |access-date=26 July 2025 |website=[[Diamond League|diamondleague.com]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=12 May 2025 |title=Diamond+ Disciplines announced for July meetings |url=https://www.diamondleague.com/diamond-disciplines-announced-for-july-meetings/ |access-date=26 July 2025 |website=[[Diamond League|diamondleague.com]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=18 June 2025 |title=Diamond+ Disciplines announced for last three series meetings |url=https://www.diamondleague.com/diamond-disciplines-announced-for-last-three-series-meetings/ |access-date=26 July 2025 |website=[[Diamond League|diamondleague.com]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=15 July 2025 |title=Diamond+ Disciplines Announced for the Wanda Diamond League Final 2025 |url=https://zurich.diamondleague.com/en/diamond-disciplines-announced-for-the-wanda-diamond-league-final-2025/ |access-date=26 July 2025 |website=[[Diamond League|diamondleague.com]]}}</ref>
